name: S3Proxy Open-Source S3-Compatible Gateway
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed S3 API proxy; run against a local filesystem or self-managed backend without a software subscription or vendor-hosted free storage quota.
watch_out: S3Proxy is an API gateway, not free cloud object storage. Requires a user-operated Java 17+ server or Docker deployment, disk, networking and backups. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Swift and SFTP backends may incur separate storage, request and egress charges; S3 API feature coverage is not complete.
